method: MERAKit.jl (Hauru 2007.03638) ternary MERA, Riemannian LBFGS, direct-init at bond dim 8, block_size=2, dense ComplexSpace. Julia 1.8.5. O'Brien-Fendley Hamiltonian lam3=0.856 (tricritical Ising, c=7/10). 6 random seeds, 2500 iters; select by spectrum quality (Delta_sigma nearest CFT 0.075).
purpose: Optional chi=8 sharpening of SIM-051 (chi=6). Sharpens the NON-universal TCI primaries (Delta_sigma, Delta_eps); confirms Delta_T (alpha) robustness at higher bond dimension.

delta_T_statistics.note: ALL 6 seeds give alpha within 1.5% of 4.0 (tighter than chi=6). Delta_T=1.9994 best basin -> alpha=3.999, essentially exact.

Delta_eps_best.note: Delta_eps NOW RESOLVED at chi=8 (0.204 vs CFT 0.2), absent/unresolved at chi=6

verdict: Sharpens and confirms SIM-051. At chi=8 the tricritical Ising tower is well-resolved: best basin (seed 1) gives Delta_sigma=0.092 (CFT 0.075), Delta_eps=0.204 (CFT 0.2 - exact!), Delta_T=1.9994 (CFT 2.0) => alpha=3.999. The energy operator Delta_eps=0.2 is now resolved (was not at chi=6), independently confirming the c=7/10 TCI universality class (not Ising c=1/2, whose eps would be 1.0). Delta_T robust across all 6 seeds (alpha 3.999-4.060). HYP-027 SUPPORTED with strengthened evidence: alpha=4 is universal at the tricritical fixed point, and the full TCI primary spectrum (sigma, eps, T) matches M(4,5).
notes: Driver research/tools/MERAKit.jl/qw_tci_chi8.jl (committed merakit-setup/qw_tci_chi8.jl 51f2c0c). Each seed ~45 min at chi=8. The Delta_eps=0.204 resolution is the decisive new datum: it pins the universality class to c=7/10 directly (Ising eps=1.0 would be unmistakably different).
